content: esm.sh serves any npm package as native ESM and documents an import-map pattern (react@19.2.x + react-dom/client bare specifiers). jsDelivr +esm is the alternative ESM CDN (Rollup-4 pipeline rebuilt, Aug 2026). Import maps are Baseline Widely Available: Chrome/Edge 89+, Firefox 108+, Safari 16.4+ (march 2023); inline-only (no src=), must precede module scripts. esm.sh also ships /run and /tsx loaders that compile JSX in-browser (localhost) or via its build API, with a 60-builds/min limit.
